about.title: It all began with a smile.
about.lead: Heloísa Chloé was born on July 7, 2026, at 11:25 a.m., bringing a joy that completely transformed her parents' lives.
story: A radiant, happy, wonderful little girl with a smile that can light up any room. Every day she delights her parents with her discoveries, her expressions and every small moment of her childhood.

story.h: It was from this love that HC — Heloísa Chloé was born.

story: Her parents shared one wish: to spend more and more time with their daughter, to follow her growth, to share in her discoveries and never let the rush of life take away the moments that matter most.
And from that wish came an idea: to create something that could represent the love, the care and the joy of watching a child grow.

story.h: That is how HC was born.

story: More than a children's clothing brand, we want to build a brand that becomes part of families' stories — from the very first days of life, through first discoveries, games, lessons and achievements, all the way to age 10.
We want to offer clothes, layettes, toys, books and experiences that make every stage even more special.
about.closing: A story that began with a little girl, was born from a family's love and dreams of reaching the whole world.
about.closingLine: Because childhood goes by fast. But the memories last forever.
about.mission: To bring comfort, quality, care and happiness to children and families all over the world.
about.vision: To be an international reference in childrenswear, known for care in every detail and the trust of families in Brazil and worldwide.

quality.d: Selected materials and a finish checked piece by piece.

comfort.d: The child's skin and freedom of movement first; everything else after.

care.d: We design as if dressing our own children.

fair.d: Premium doesn't have to be out of reach.

durability.d: Clothes that survive the wash and get handed down.

inclusion.d: Boys and girls, here and around the world — the same crown for every child.

about.journeyTitle: HC grows up with your child.

contact.lead: We're here to help with sizes, gifts, exchanges and orders.

shipping.a: Everywhere in Brazil. Delivery time and cost appear in the bag once you enter your CEP. Free standard shipping over R$ 299.

exchange.a: Your first exchange is free within 30 days. You may also cancel your purchase within 7 days of delivery.

sizes.q: How do I choose a size?
sizes.a: Use the size guide on each product page. Between two sizes, choose the larger one — babies grow fast.

payment.q: Which payment methods will be accepted?
payment.a: Pix, credit card and boleto, processed by a certified provider. Online payment will be enabled at the official launch.

international.a: Not yet, but the site is already available in Portuguese, English and Japanese, ready for international expansion.

care.q: How should I care for the pieces?
care.a: A delicate cold wash, inside out, no bleach and drying in the shade keep colours and embroidery looking new.
